nodes.label: Make It Ezy Mascot Image
nodes.description: Photorealistic 3D render of the 'Y U NO' rage-comic character on a transparent background: bald round head, bloodshot wide eyes, furrowed brow, open shouting mouth, both hands raised palms-up in an exasperated gesture. Serves as the project's logo/mascot.
nodes.rationale: Mascot conveys the project's premise: frustration at things being hard ('why you no make it easy?'), which the tool answers by making skill discovery and setup easy.

nodes.label: Make It Ezy Branding / Mascot
nodes.rationale: Humorous, frustrated-user persona frames the product as the fix for tedious setup.
